audit.method: the collection's PDF of the act's current version (its pdf_link, a second rendering of the same text), its words against the words of the version held here (97% or more found = agrees)

lexwork-basel-stadt|switzerland/basel-st.note: www.gesetzessammlung.bs.ch: index of 1039 acts (1039 in force); held 903; 0 in force and in scope not held yet, 135 out of scope (land-use plans, concessions, directives, forms: as the builder), 1 published only as PDF; 129 held acts compared with the collection this check (every one within 7 days); 0 candidate acts read

verify.method: each act compared this check (129 of 903: a seventh of the held acts, every one within 7 days, and the acts this check wrote) read again from www.gesetzessammlung.bs.ch (the act document and each version by id); every version held here against the collection's XHTML of the same day, letters and digits (the builder's letters check, ch_cantons.letters_check, so how a parse splits the text into files does not count); and the corpus's newest version rendered by the builder (gitlaw_common) against the files at the tip of main. A difference is corrected by the next check's update when today's parse gives back the act's other held versions exactly; otherwise it is listed for a rebuild decision
verify.not_compared_why: acts held from parts built by another route (not the collection's XHTML through the builder's parse), e.g. a verification pass or PDF annexes
